title: Co się stało?
focus: aspect in storytelling: background and process vs. events and results

lines.speaker: Tomek
lines.pl: Wczoraj, kiedy wracałem|wracalem z Gdańska|gdanska, zgubiłem|zgubilem plecak.
lines.en: Yesterday, on my way back from Gdańsk, I lost my backpack.

lines.speaker: Tomek
lines.pl: Siedziałem|siedzialem w pociągu|pociagu, czytałem|czytalem książkę i nagle zasnąłem|zasnalem.
lines.en: I was sitting on the train, reading a book, and suddenly I fell asleep.

lines.speaker: Tomek
lines.pl: Kiedy się obudziłem|obudzilem, plecaka|plecaka już nie było|bylo.
lines.en: When I woke up, the backpack was gone.

lines.speaker: Ania
lines.pl: O nie! Szukałeś|szukales go|go? Pytałeś|pytales konduktora|konduktora?
lines.en: Oh no! Did you look for it? Did you ask the conductor?

lines.speaker: Tomek
lines.pl: Szukałem|szukalem przez godzinę|godzine, ale nie znalazłem|znalazlem. Na szczęście ktoś go oddał|oddal na dworcu|dworcu w Warszawie|warszawie.
lines.en: I looked for an hour, but I didn’t find it. Luckily someone handed it in at the station in Warsaw.

lines.speaker: Ania
lines.pl: No to masz szczęście|szczescie! Wszystko było w środku|srodku?
lines.en: Well, you’re lucky! Was everything inside?

stalo.tags: verb · perfective · past · 3rd person singular · neuter
stalo.why: Co się stało?, “what happened?”: co is treated as neuter, so the verb is neuter. Stać się is perfective: something happened, once.

wygladasz.why: Wyglądać takes an adverb where English uses an adjective: wyglądasz okropnie, “you look awful”; dobrze wyglądasz, “you look good.”

wracalem.gloss: to return, be on the way back
wracalem.tags: verb · imperfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
wracalem.why: Imperfective: the journey home is the background, in progress when something else happened. The perfective wróciłem would mean he had already arrived.

gdanska.tags: proper noun · masculine inanimate · genitive singular
gdanska.why: Z meaning “from” takes the genitive: z Gdańska, z Krakowa.

zgubilem.tags: verb · perfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
zgubilem.why: Perfective: a single event that interrupts the background. Masculine forms insert an e before the person marker.

siedzialem.tags: verb · imperfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
siedzialem.why: Imperfective: a state that lasted, the scene in which the events take place.

pociagu.why: W + locative. Stems ending in k, g or ch take -u: w pociągu, w bloku.

czytalem.tags: verb · imperfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
czytalem.why: Imperfective: an activity going on in the background. Nothing says he finished the book; przeczytałem would.

zasnalem.tags: verb · perfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
zasnalem.why: Perfective: a sudden event against the background of siedziałem and czytałem. Verbs in -nąć keep ą in the masculine singular and have ę everywhere else: zasnąłem, but zasnęłam, zasnęli.

obudzilem.tags: verb · perfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
obudzilem.why: Perfective: the moment of waking. Kiedy with a perfective verb means “once, at the moment when.”

plecaka.why: Saying something isn’t there takes the genitive: plecaka nie było, “the backpack wasn’t there.” Compare plecak był, “the backpack was there.”

bylo.why: Nie było + genitive has no grammatical subject, so the verb is neuter singular whatever the noun: nie było plecaka, nie było ludzi.

szukales.tags: verb · imperfective · past · 2nd person singular · masculine
szukales.why: Imperfective: Ania asks about the activity, not the result. Szukać takes the genitive: szukać plecaka, szukałeś go.

go.why: Go is the short form of both the genitive and the accusative of on. Here it’s genitive, because szukać takes the genitive. It refers to plecak, a masculine noun, so English “it.”

pytales.tags: verb · imperfective · past · 2nd person singular · masculine
pytales.why: Imperfective: did any asking happen at all? Zapytałeś would focus on one completed question.

konduktora.why: Pytać takes a person in the accusative, and for masculine personal nouns that has the genitive form: pytać konduktora.

szukalem.tags: verb · imperfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
szukalem.why: Szukałem, ale nie znalazłem is the classic pair: imperfective szukać is the effort, perfective znaleźć the result. The effort can go on without success.

godzine.why: Przez + accusative says how long something lasted: przez godzinę, “for an hour.” It goes naturally with imperfective verbs.

znalazlem.tags: verb · perfective · past · 1st person singular · masculine
znalazlem.why: Perfective: the result, which never came. Znaleźć is irregular: znalazłem, znalazła, but virile znaleźli.

oddal.tags: verb · perfective · past · 3rd person singular · masculine
oddal.why: Ktoś, “someone”, takes a masculine verb even when nobody knows who it was.

dworcu.why: Na + locative: na dworcu, “at the station.” Two changes at once: the fleeting e drops and rz becomes r: dworzec, dworca, na dworcu.

parts: loc. sg. -e (the i marks w softened)
stem (ść spelled ści before a vowel)
szczescie.why: Mieć szczęście means “to be lucky”; na szczęście means “luckily.” The same word also means “happiness.”

srodku.why: W środku, “inside”: w + locative, with the fleeting e of środek dropped.

zjadl.tags: verb · perfective · past · 3rd person singular · masculine
zjadl.why: Perfective: the sandwiches are gone. Jeść has the past stem jad-: jadł, zjadł; feminine zjadła, virile plural zjedli.

kanapki.why: Direct object of zjadł, in the accusative plural.
kanapki.history: A diminutive of kanapa, “sofa”, echoing French canapé, which means both.

exercises.prompt: Background in progress: “I was writing an email when the phone rang.” ___ maila, kiedy zadzwonił telefon.

explain.m: Imperfective pisać, no prefix: an action in progress. Napisałem would mean the email was finished.
explain.f: Imperfective pisać, no prefix: an action in progress. Napisałam would mean the email was finished.

exercises.hint: Compare czytałem książkę. Would na- make sense for something unfinished?

exercises.prompt: “I looked for my keys but didn’t find them”: Szukał(a)m kluczy, ale ich nie ___.

explain.m: The result that didn’t come: perfective znaleźć, znalaz + ł + e + m.
explain.f: The result that didn’t come: perfective znaleźć, znalaz + ł + a + m.

exercises.hint: Szukać is the effort. Which verb is the result?

exercises.explain: Absence takes the genitive: nie było chleba.
Outside the masculine singular, -nąć verbs have ę: zasnęła.
exercises.hint: Zasnąłem keeps ą because it’s masculine. What about a woman?

exercises.prompt: “I’m coming from the station” (dworzec): Idę z ___.
exercises.explain: Z meaning “from” takes the genitive. As in the locative, the e drops and rz becomes r: z dworca.
exercises.hint: Look at how dworzec changes in na dworcu.
